title: MissionSimulateRequest
description: Surface-stay mission simulation (ENGINEERING tier): Sun/Earth visibility (scenario evaluation), optional direct-to-Earth radio link, optional site slope check, a solar-array + battery energy balance, mission constraints and a landing delay. Every vehicle figure (panels, battery, loads, radio) is supplied by the caller; the services assume none. Angles in degrees, lengths in metres, power in W, energy in Wh, UTC ISO 8601 with a literal 'Z'.

step_minutes.description: Simulation step. At most 20000 samples: floor(surface_hours*60/step)+1, on the PLANNED stay (an upper bound: a delay never lengthens it).

terrain_mode.description: Horizon for Sun/Earth visibility, as in ScenarioRequest.

delay.description: Delay injected BEFORE landing (transit / orbit). Omitted = no delay.

landing_delay_hours.description: Landing happens at landing_utc + this delay.

end_policy.description: 'fixed_duration': the stay keeps surface_hours and ends later. 'fixed_end': the planned end time is kept (e.g. a fixed departure window), so the stay is shortened by the delay.

pre_landing_net_load_w.description: Net battery draw while waiting before landing (load minus any generation in flight). null = not modelled: the battery reaches the surface with its initial charge.

power.description: Solar array + battery. OPTIONAL (lowest priority): omitted or null = energy not modelled; energy fields of the response are null and min_battery_soc is not evaluated.

panel_efficiency.description: End-to-end array efficiency (cells, temperature, wiring, regulation).

panel_pointing.description: 'sun_tracking': normal toward the Sun (cos i = 1). 'vertical': vertical panel turned toward the Sun's azimuth (cos i = cos elevation). 'horizontal': flat panel (cos i = sin elevation).

battery_initial_soc.description: State of charge before the delay (and at landing without delay).

radio.description: Direct-to-Earth link (as RadioLinkRequest). null/omitted = contact time is geometric Earth visibility only, and no data volume is computed.

min_battery_soc.description: Battery reserve never to be crossed.

max_earth_outage_hours.description: Longest allowed gap in contact (link if radio is given, else geometric Earth visibility).

max_slope_deg.description: Slope limit for the landing zone (20 m DEM slope, 4 km disc).

min_slope_ok_fraction.description: Share of the zone that must be <= max_slope_deg (default 1 when max_slope_deg is set).

search.description: Correction search (retime after the delay, and the two-sided date scan). Omitted = defaults.

max_extra_delay_hours.description: How far to look: after the delayed landing (retime) and on each side of the planned landing (date scan).
